_note: A `types` entry points at a build-time-generated .d.ts that does not exist yet (e.g. `unplugin-auto-import` output before the first build). The entry is inherited as written, as svelte-check's overlay inherits it, and tsgo reports a TS2688 with no file or position. svelte-check --tsgo 4.7.7 reports it on the project tsconfig at 1:1, quoting the entry as written, and so do we.
